title: Surreal journeys — compare the new passages

clips.label: Through the living book
clips.note: Fruit → garden → railway → library → paper forest
clips.details:
This review omits the identical first 10⅔ seconds. Player time zero is the shared garden painting. The complete film remains available in the session report and chat.

A 26⅔-second continuous recurrent journey. The earlier fruit/city/fish opening is preserved. From 10⅔ seconds, travel through the garden opening to balloon stations, then follow the train into a library and through a glowing arch toward a paper forest. The route adapts to forms that appeared in the preceding painting. Some major redraws still produce ghosted intermediate details.

Krea Turbo repaints its own warped previous painting using three Euler intervals, CFG1 and scene-specific noise ramps. Lanczos controls spatial movement. RIFE 4.25 scale 1 fills the gaps and never feeds back. 24 fps delivery, three paintings per displayed second; all diffusion paintings are preserved. This is a 1.5× edition of the recorded source timeline.
